preconditions.expression: V >= 1 and all(0 <= u < V for neighbors in adj for u in neighbors)
preconditions.description: V is a positive integer, and all vertices in adjacency lists are valid (0 ≤ u < V).
Adjacency list is well-formed (no negative lengths).

preconditions.expression: all(u == v or u != v for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: No self-loops are considered as edges (u != v for all edges).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= v < V for v in return_value) or return_value == [-1]
postconditions.description: All returned vertices are valid (0 ≤ v < V), or return [-1] if no articulation points exist.
Returned list contains unique vertices in sorted order, or [-1] if empty.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [-1] or all(remove_vertex_disconnects(V, adj, v) for v in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every returned vertex is an articulation point (removing it increases connected components).

postconditions.expression: return_value == [-1] or all(not remove_vertex_disconnects(V, adj, v) for v in range(V) if v not in return_value)
postconditions.description: No non-returned vertex is an articulation point (completeness).
